entities.summary: Beniamino Stella is an Italian prelate of the Catholic Church. After working in the diplomatic corps of the Holy See, he served as prefect of the Congregation for the Clergy from 2013 to 2021. He was raised to the rank of cardinal by Pope Francis in 2014.
